title: Editor crashes in Input Map settings when rapidly pressing escape just after adding an input event
body: ### Tested versions Reproducible in : v4.7.dev.custom_build [778cf54da] Reproducible in (without a crash) : v4.3.stable.official [77dcf97d8] ### System information Godot v4.7.dev (778cf54da) - macOS Tahoe (26.3.0) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - Apple M2 - Apple M2 (8 threads) - 16.00 Gio memory ### Issue description In Input Map settings, when you press escape just after adding an input event to an action, the editor crashes. The editor also crashes when instead of adding an input event, you edit an input event. ``` handle_crash: Program crashed with signal 11 Engine version: Godot Engine v4.7.dev.custom_build (778cf54dabd8a9e25b698a87036ab8604183f303) Dumping the backtrace. Note that when testing on Godot 4.3, it doesn't crash, the window just appears blank : ### Steps to reproduce 1. Create a new project 2. Open Input Map settings. 3. Create new action named "test" (name doesn't matter) 4. Click on "+" to add an input event, and just after press Escape. Try multiple times if it doesn't work. ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) N/A
